children: Shares of Paysign rose after the company lifted its profitability outlook for the year and reported third-quarter earnings and revenue ahead of Wall Street expectations.
The stock jumped 12% to $14.00 after-hours on Monday. Shares closed down 15% at $12.51, up 143% through the close.
The company reported a profit of $6.7 million, or 11 cents a share, compared with a profit of $2.2 million, or 4 cents a share, a year earlier.
Revenue rose to $30.8 million from $21.6 million a year prior.
Analysts surveyed by FactSet were expecting earnings of 9 cents a share on $29 million in revenue.

For the full year, the company reiterated its outlook for revenue between $114 million and $117 million, while raising its outlook for earnings per share to a range of 37 cents to 38 cents from an earlier range of 35 cents to 37 cents.
Analysts are expecting full-year earnings of 35 cents a share on $114.7 million in revenue.
